d: Alakshendr apni sena men vyapt asantosh aur bhay ko dur karne ke lie unhen protsahit karta hai. vahin dusri or kshudrak ganrajy aur malav ganrajy men ahankar ke takrav ko dekh vishnugupt aahat hain. alakshendr malav ganrajy par hamla karta hai aur kshudrak ganrajy ki sena na aa pane ke karan parajit ho jata hai. ....phir kya hota hai dekhie is bhag men
